metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to decompress your lower back at home using a resistance band.

This exercise will take pressure off the lumbar spine and spinal discs, which may give lower back pain relief within seconds. It's especially effective for herniated discs (bulging discs) that may be causing sharp, shooting sciatica leg pain. 

Let us know how it works for you!

Link to pull up band: https://amzn.to/3PH3dRT
